text_block_list.text:
We planned to start training first thing in
the
afternoon today, but I got stuck in a
meeting that
ended late. When I finally
make it over to the
track...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I get that you were busy, but how could
you leave
me waiting all alone?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Even I get lonely sometimes, you know!
Hmph!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Instead of training, I end up spending
most of our
time apologizing to her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
